'''Kronas''' was the first [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Kattellyn system]],<ref name="PoG2" /> located in the [[Rolion sector/Legends|Rolion sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]].<ref name="TEA-OC" /> It was a ball of searing rock that [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] too close to its [[Kattellyn|sun]].<ref name="PoG2" />
